title: Shared mode foundation: modes law, inactive surface, objective fact port, response decorator, composite function gates, VC provisioning, Wave-I ledger
rules: MF1 Modes law (internal/domain/modes, pure). Day(t) = floor((unix + 28800 - 18000) / 86400) (F7); Week(t) = the Day of the Monday 05:00 GMT+8 that starts t's week (D84). Counter{Period, Used} normalizes lazily: a read in a later period starts at 0. Ladder{Prices, Beyond REFUSE|CLAMP_LAST}.Price(n) is the price of the n-th buy (1-based) as the client RefreshCostTable reads it. Sweep admission for star-bearing modes: star == 3, 1 <= count <= max. Starless Pet Campaign uses durable prior accepted victory: a nonempty normal interval current+1 through lifetime best, or an already cleared elite floor, with its ticket/time/entitlement gates. No stars are fabricated; unchanged AdmitSweep remains for star-bearing modes (D262). Existing family Day helpers move only when their stage edits them, with an equality test.

MF2 Inactive surface (F5, D83). Generated from I9_MODE_SURFACE_V1: every LATER, INACTIVE_D79 and INACTIVE_SUPERSEDED MID without a registered dispatcher answers HTTP 200 {"error_code": 1}, changes nothing, needs no session, and journals outcome INACTIVE_MODE (class ROUTINE, no raw envelope). A MID with a dispatcher keeps it (56, 59, 229, 234, 768, 781, 1537). Migration 00079 widens client_request_journal.outcome.

MF3 Objective fact port (F11). i5 ObjectiveFacts.RecordTx(ctx, t, facts) locks the player's open objective rows, applies each fact to rows whose definition accepts its kind (objective.ApplyFact, receipt identity objective-fact dedups a fact key) and saves them, inside the producer's transaction. With no matching rows it is a no-op. Producers in I9-2 (D97): every lobby PK mode settlement records kind PVP_FIGHT (objective.PVPFightKind), delta 1, attacker only, business key the fight/match id: Top Floor settleTx, 1on1 settleMatchTx, Arena settleMatchTx (not practice, not forfeit) and Champion League terminal (not void) (task_req 106).

MF4 Crystal spend ledger (D92). i5store SaveScalarTx records old - new into player_crystal_spend_days(player_id, game_day, spent) whenever crystal decreases, game_day = MF1 Day of the balance's updated_at. I5 read port CrystalSpentOnDayTx(player, day) is what I9-4 reads for task_req 126/127 as high water.

MF5 Response decorator (F17, D93). foundation/changes keeps a request change set in the context; tx.Runner stages each attempt and keeps it only after a clean commit (ambiguous commits keep nothing). Writers: SaveScalarTx (balance), progression save (exp, lev), function unlock insert (function id). stockruntime.Decorated renders economy_ and new_funcs_ on HTTP 200 object bodies without error_code; keys the dispatcher wrote win; new_funcs_ is the union. Mission deltas and redmarks_ are added by I9-4 through the same change set.

MF6 Composite function gates (D64, D91). function gate kind 2 '2|S' and kind 3 '3|L|V' are read by i5 from the compiled raw_open_value; the catalog keeps gate_kind UNSUPPORTED_COMPOSITE so the content revision does not move (D95). i5 opens kind 3 on level-up (VIP from the privilege snapshot) and on VIP change (privilege transition effect); i5 OpenStageFunctionsTx(player, normal campaign id) opens kind 2 and is called by I9-3 settlement. Openings write eligibility + unlock rows like pure level gates and record the function ids in the change set (MF5). Kinds 4, 6, 7, 8 and stages absent from campaign.lua (93, 94) stay closed.

MF7 VC provisioner (D88). virtualclient/provision raises level through i5 AdminGrant PLAYER_EXP lines (production level-up and openings), fragments and mana through AdminGrant, VIP through commerceprivilege ImportManual when a scenario needs it. Remaining shortcuts (D96): the tutorial guide cursor (until I9-3 drives the tutorial through stock MID26) and the kind 6/7 gates (until I9-7 owns them).

MF8 Proof. Unit: Day/Week across 05:00 and Monday, counter rollover, ladder REFUSE/CLAMP_LAST, sweep admission, gate parsing, decorator merge, change-set staging. Native (PostgreSQL): fact recorder dedup, spend ledger, kind-3 on level-up and VIP import, kind-2 opener. VC: every inactive MID of a sample per disposition answers error_code 1 and journals INACTIVE_MODE; a provisioned player levels through AdminGrant and MID1 func_ids show the level gates. Strict gate with r4 tools.
MF9 Wave-I ledger. Each PASS421 fixture has one owner below; a stage that owns a fixture executes it in its native or VC tests and names the test in its closure.
